results.title: Wisconsin’s Baseball Pioneer Reedsburg Makes History Again: 14U Team Advances to Babe Ruth World Series
results.description: n 1951, the city of Reedsburg made Wisconsin sports history by hosting the state’s very first Little League team—a legacy the community proudly celebrated for its 75th anniversary earlier this year. Now, the historic baseball town has another historic milestone to celebrate. The Reedsburg 14U Babe Ruth baseball team is headed to the Babe Ruth World Series after capturing the Regional Championship over the weekend in dramatic, walk-off fashion in Kentucky.
